audit_policy: Only metadata validity was checked during construction. Do not extract or score audit until architecture, calibration, ranking and threshold are frozen.
limitations: Gallery multiplicity and camera mix are local and not known to represent hidden data.
Cameras overlap across roles; this is not an unseen-camera test.
Audit has two extra known-query images; bootstrap identities/linked scenes, not independent frames.
Hash-order unknown draw differs from EDA's illustrative NumPy draw; frozen v1 capacities are authoritative for these episodes.
selection_rule: SHA256 UTF-8 of seed|role|purpose|ID; ascending digest, then string ID tie break. Primary query per identity; reserve feasible extra known queries, then cross-camera positives, then fill gallery.
